description: Quantity Engine v0 benchmark library. Derives BOQ-style quantities (ceiling_area, flooring_area, partition_length, partition_area, drywall/glass split, paint_area) from gross fit-out area + building grade (+ optional layout) when no measured takeoff exists. Deterministic: formulas live in core/quantity_engine.py, every number lives here (single source, same rule as holidays / city permits / productivity rates). All values are uncalibrated office fit-out rules of thumb for mainland China Grade A/B/C office buildings and MUST be replaced by measured BOQ when available.

net_ceiling_ratio.description: Share of gross fit-out area that receives a new suspended ceiling. Deducts core, risers, shafts, exposed-soffit zones (pantry/BOH/feature open ceiling).

net_floor_ratio.description: Share of gross area that receives new floor finish (carpet tile / raised floor / stone / LVT). Deducts cores, columns, shafts, wet areas retained from base build.

partition_density_m_per_m2.description: Linear metres of new internal partition (drywall + glazed) per m2 gross. Lower for open-plan trading floors, higher for cellular offices.

partition_height_m.description: Average partition height. Full-height (to slab) drywall for acoustic separation in Grade A; ceiling-height partitions in lower grades.

glass_partition_share.description: Share of partition length that is framed/frameless glazing rather than drywall. Glazing is neither boarded nor painted.

core_wall_density_m_per_m2.description: Linear metres of existing base-build wall (core, shaft, perimeter columns) that receive skim + paint in the fit-out.

painted_face_fraction.description: Share of a drywall face that is actually painted after deducting doors, openings, skirting, wall panelling / vinyl / feature finishes.

painted_ceiling_share.description: Share of ceiling area that is painted gypsum bulkhead / plasterboard rather than unpainted lay-in tile.

A.label_zh: 甲级办公楼 (外企总部标准)
assumptions: net_ceiling_ratio 0.85 equals the legacy suspended_ceiling bridge ratio, so Grade A + default layout reproduces the PR #3 pilot quantity exactly.
Slab-to-slab 4.0-4.5 m, raised floor 100-150 mm, finished ceiling 2.8-3.0 m; meeting-room partitions run full height to slab for acoustics -> 3.5 m average partition height.
Open-plan workstation ratio high, but many glazed meeting rooms / phone booths -> 0.30 m/m2 partition density with 35% glazing.
More gypsum bulkheads and feature ceilings than lower grades -> 30% of ceiling area painted.
More wall panelling / acoustic finishes in front-of-house -> only 85% of drywall face is painted.

B.label_zh: 乙级办公楼 (国内企业标准)
assumptions: Slab-to-slab 3.8-4.0 m, ceiling-height or part-height partitions -> 3.2 m average.
More cellular offices, less glazing (25%) -> 0.35 m/m2 partition density.
Mostly lay-in mineral fibre ceiling with 20% painted gypsum bulkheads.

C.label_zh: 丙级办公楼 (经济型/后台办公)
assumptions: Some back-of-house left with exposed / existing soffit -> net_ceiling_ratio 0.80.
Cellular layout with painted drywall rather than glazing -> 0.40 m/m2 partition density, 10% glazing.
Minimal bulkheads -> 10% of ceiling painted; almost the whole drywall face is painted (95%).

standard.label: Standard mix of open plan and meeting rooms

partition_area.formula: partition_length * partition_height_m  (single-face wall surface, standard stud-partition measurement)

paint_area.formula: drywall_partition_area * 2 faces * painted_face_fraction + gross_area * core_wall_density_m_per_m2 * partition_height_m * painted_face_fraction + ceiling_area * painted_ceiling_share

sanity_ranges_per_gross_m2.description: Engine self-check: derived quantity / gross_area must fall inside these bands or a warning is emitted (never silently). Bands bracket the A/B/C benchmarks with any layout modifier applied.

rounding: round to 0.1 unit after all multiplications (matches legacy bridge round(area*ratio, 1))
